title: An algorithmic Polynomial Freiman-Ruzsa theorem
summary: We provide algorithmic versions of the Polynomial Freiman-Ruzsa theorem of Gowers, Green, Manners, and Tao (Ann. of Math., 2025). In particular, we give a polynomial-time algorithm that, given a set $A \subseteq \mathbb{F}_2^n$ with doubling constant $K$, returns a subspace $V \subseteq \mathbb{F}_2^n$ of size $|V| \leq |A|$ such that $A$ can be covered by $2K^C$ translates of $V$, for a universal constant $C>1$.
